messages:
maya: FYI I noticed p95 on /v1/generate in prod-us-east spiked ~180ms right after we changed routing weights. No infra deploy at the time. Screenshot: https://console.redwood/snap.png
rafael: opened logs. My initial thought: merged-percentile semantics. We merge tdigests from dedicated + hosted pools for endpoint-level percentiles, so a weight shift can move the p95 without any node-level regression.
sam: Yup. This is why endpoint-level p50/p95/p99 are dangerous during rollouts. People expect a single source of truth but the API currently returns a merged tdigest.
lisa: UX idea: show a small provenance toast on endpoint views: "Most samples from: dedicated (64%)" and a one-click "breakdown by route" toggle. Also add an inline explainer: "percentiles shown are aggregated across routes and may change when routing weights update."
maya: I like the toast + toggle. Also: our alerting is wired to endpoint p95 right now for that SLO. If the pctl moves because of routing, we generate false positives. We need to pin alerts to route-level metrics or change alert logic to ignore provenance-only shifts.
metrics-bot: metric-alert: p95 threshold exceeded for /v1/generate (prod-us-east) at 2024-06-15T13:04:12Z.
rafael: API proposal: add query params to metrics endpoint: `merge_mode` with values `tdigest`(current), `per-route-weighted`, `per-route-max` and `provenance=true` to return sample counts per route. Clients can request `by=route` too. That keeps backward compatibility but lets consumers opt-in for route-aware views.
sam: For SLOs, we should recommend binding alerts to `route` level or to `merge_mode=per-route-weighted` along with a minimum sample-count guard. I'll add test cases that simulate weight flips and assert no alert churn.
lisa: I'll prototype the UI toast + toggle and wire it to show `provenance` data when available. Small copy: "Percentiles aggregated across routes. Toggle to view by route"
maya: Owners: maya -> alerting runbook update + incident note, rafael -> API params PR, sam -> alert test harness, lisa -> UI canary. Rafael/sam, can you agree on param names? I can ship UI change as a console canary next deploy.
rafael: Agree on `merge_mode` and `provenance`. I'll jot up a short API doc & compatibility note. For `per-route-max`, semantics: return the max pctl among routes (useful for conservative SLOs).
sam: I'll add unit + e2e tests and a synthetic that flips weights to 0.1/0.9 and verifies endpoint p95 moves while route-level p95s stay stable.
lisa: Adding tooltip copy and a small "why did p95 change" link to docs.
maya: Thanks. If we can get API + UI canary out in next deploy, should reduce pager noise.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: console-canary -> 2024-06-16T02:00:00Z (includes UI provenance toast).
rafael: Opening API PR now: RFC in #pr-links when ready.
